resources.string: Turn off your phone display while casting to your TV without dropping the stream. Save battery and prevent OLED burn-in.

Instructions:

• Tap the "Cast Screen Off" tile in Quick Settings to blank display while casting.
• Double-press Volume Up anytime to wake the screen.
• ⚠️ Avoid pressing the physical Power button while blanked to prevent putting the phone to sleep.
Second screen detected and managed by CastOff.
Connect to a wireless display and control two independent screens

Instructions for Dual Display:

• Connect to a wireless display via Settings > Connected Devices > Cast.
• Tap 'Start Dual Display' to create independent SC2 on your TV.
• Use the floating controller bubble to move apps to the TV.
• CastOff blanking (screen off) still works — SC2 stays active.
• Double-press Volume Up to wake phone without affecting TV.
